title: Attio API review: seats, credits and a real rate limit
snippet:
Nothing about the Attio API is metered. Calls cost nothing, the free plan includes API access, and what you actually pay for is seats and credits: $44 per user a month on Plus, $99 on Pro, or nothing at all on Free. Credits are consumed by enrichment and AI features inside the product, not by your own API calls.

Attio API pricing is really seat pricing. Four tiers, each adding credits per seat and capabilities rather than API access, because every tier already has that.
### Free
$0
per user/month
- Full REST API access
- 100 seat credits a month
- 250 workspace credits a month
### Plus

### Pro
$99
/user/mo, $79 annual

- 10,000 workspace credits a month
- The tier Attio marks as popular
### Enterprise
Custom
billed annually
- 2,500 seat credits a month
- Custom workspace credits
Workspace credits can be topped up at $85 a month for an extra 5,000, or $70 a month on an annual commitment. Annual billing takes roughly 20% off every seat price. The free plan is a real plan rather than a trial, and because API access is on it, you can build and test an integration end to end before anyone is billed.

- Full REST API on the free plan, so you can build and test before anyone is billed.
- You define the objects and attributes, so the schema matches your motion rather than a vendor's idea of a deal.

The free plan makes the evaluation honest. Full API access, your own schema, no card: build the integration you are worried about and find out whether the write limit is a problem before you have bought a single seat.
Do not buy it to save money on a large team. At $44 to $99 per user a month, Attio is not cheap next to HubSpot's free tier, and the reason to choose it is the data model and the developer platform rather than the price. If nobody on your team is going to write code against it, you are paying for the half of the product you will not use.

Is the Attio API free?
Free plan with full API access, 100 seat credits a month. Paid use starts at $44/user/mo.
How much does the Attio API cost?
Attio starts at $44/user/mo. It bills per seat, by subscription, with a free tier. Read from Attio's own pricing page on 24 October 2026.

title: Attio API Review [August 2026]: Limits & ZoomInfo
snippet:
**Attio's API** is a public REST surface exchanging JSON over HTTPS, with [OAuth 2.0 authentication](https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/guides/authentication) for multi-workspace apps and API keys for single-workspace use, published rate limits of [100 reads/sec and 25 writes/sec](https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/guides/rate-limiting), a webhook system with [at-least-once delivery guarantees](https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/guides/webhooks), and an endpoint catalogue spanning custom objects, records, lists, notes, tasks, files, meetings, and call recordings.
The [developer docs](https://docs.attio.com) are public, an [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/endpoint-reference/openapi) is downloadable, and API access ships on every plan, including free.

| **Pricing / access** | Bundled on all plans including Free ($0); no separate API tier or per-call charges |

| API access on every plan, including Free ($0) | CRM scope only: no external contact search, no enrichment endpoints, no intent signals |

Getting API access starts with any **Attio** account, including the free tier.
There is no separate developer signup, no approval gate, and no enterprise-only restriction. API and webhook access is [available on all plans](https://attio.com/pricing).

One practical advantage: because API access ships on every plan, you can prototype an integration on the free tier (3 seats, 50,000 records, 3 objects) and upgrade only when you need more capacity.

The number of custom objects is plan-gated: 3 on Free (including People and Companies), 5 on Plus, 12 on Pro, and unlimited on Enterprise.

**Attio** bundles API and [webhook access](https://attio.com/pricing) on all plans, including the free tier.
There is no separate API pricing, no per-call metering for standard REST API usage, and no API-specific credit system. The App SDK and MCP server are also available across all plans.
What each plan gives you at the API level:
- **Free ($0):** 3 seats, 50,000 records, 3 objects, API and webhook access
- **Plus ($29/user/month annual, $36 monthly):** No seat limit, 250,000 records, 5 objects
- **Pro ($69/user/month annual, $86 monthly):** 1,000,000 records, 12 objects, priority support
- **Enterprise (custom pricing):** Unlimited objects, custom record limits, SSO, migration service
The SQL endpoint via MCP is an exception: it is not available on every billing plan.
